cohort: The study included 343 patients with obesity aged 18 and older who received laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (LSG) between 2019 and 2023.
finding: Gastritis was common after laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy, affecting 70.3% of patients, with female gender, hypothyroidism, cesarean section history, and H. pylori infection identified as significant risk factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section history increased the risk of gastritis by three-fold.
cross-section timing: Post-operative, after laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy, with examination of pre- and post-operative factors.
